svg.text: push main -> dev (automatic) · tag vX.Y.Z-rc.N -> dev -> uat · tag vX.Y.Z -> dev -> uat -> prod · manual: cd.yml (cloud(s) + first stage + tag) or deploy-env.yml

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. promotion policy: dev sha-* / v*, uat vX.Y.Z[-rc.N], prod vX.Y.Z

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. OIDC login (azure/login · google-github-actions/auth) - no stored cloud keys

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. cosign verify of all 6 images (built by container.yml on main)

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. copy by digest into the environment registry; GKE: Binary Authorization attestation

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. helm upgrade --install --atomic (helm-release.sh), every component pinned by digest

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6. smoke tests: rollout status, pods run exactly the promoted digests, SMOKE_URLS

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7. smoke failure -> automatic helm rollback (migrations forward-only, expand / contract)

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • own Terraform state, subscription / project, cluster and Key Vault per environment

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Helm overlays environments/<cloud>/<dev|uat|prod>.yaml (+ client values file)

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • identical signed digests promoted - never rebuilt between stages

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • dev: 1 zone, Flyway in the app · uat / prod: HA, pre-upgrade Flyway Job

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • prod: requireImageDigests, private cluster, WAF Prevention + adaptive

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • uat / prod: MFA for partner / TPA roles; synthetic data only below prod

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • GitHub Environments azure-<env> / gcp-<env>: reviewers set in repo settings
